answer.explanation: In the window, every ThumbnailerFunction invocation fails with NoSuchBucket on PutObject. The OUTPUT_BUCKET value is 'missing-bucket-lambda-rca', a bucket that does not exist. The live configuration matches the IaC template, so this is not drift. The template hardcodes the value, while the other functions use !Ref to the OutputBucket resource. The error is NoSuchBucket rather than AccessDenied, so IAM is not the cause. The IAM role grants s3:PutObject on the real OutputBucket, and the function was not changed in the window.
